intro: Quit Right Blend is an ayurvedic powder crafted to provide supportive care for individuals reducing or quitting addictive habits. The herbs work synergistically to promote calm, aid detoxification, and maintain nervous system wellness, helping adherence to lifestyle changes. Best results come with counseling, hydration, nutritious meals, and sleep hygiene; outcomes vary by individual commitment. This is a supportive supplement, not a medical treatment.
